title: New law: A joint resolution to designate January 28, 1987, as "National Challenger Center Day" to honor the crew of the space shuttle Challenger. (Public Law 100-3)
summary: S.J.Res. 24 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-3 on 1987-01-28.

title: New law: A joint resolution to provide for a temporary prohibition of strikes or lockouts with respect to the Long Island Rail Road labor-management dispute. (Public Law 100-2)
summary: H.J.Res. 93 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-2 on 1987-01-28.

title: New law: A joint resolution extending the time within which the President may transmit the Economic Report to the Congress. (Public Law 100-1)
summary: H.J.Res. 88 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-1 on 1987-01-28.
